info.name: Logistics Network
info.description: Run 01 then 02 then 03 then 04. CRUD reference folders are independent manual tests; adapt values to current state.

item.name: Warehouse CRUD — run on dedicated test records
item.description: Reference requests. Adapt IDs/state before running. Shipment items require CREATED shipment; invoices require DELIVERED shipment. PUT preserves protected business state. Do not run all CRUD folders as a workflow.
